description: Enhanced per-service request-size edge cases: a request body exactly equal to the configured maximum is accepted and forwarded to the backend, while a body one byte over the maximum is rejected with a payload-too-large response and never reaches the backend. Each registration reports success and each probe reports the response status with the body.

cases.expected_output:
deploy s1 ok
status=200 target=app-ok
status=413 target=Request too large
